title: Open Fluorescence Map module (dev route) and validate core shell renders
description: Navigate to the dev-only Fluorescence Map route and confirm the map container and view-mode toolbar are present.
steps: Navigate to /_dev/fluorescence-map?testsprite=1
Wait for the view toolbar to appear (role='toolbar' and aria-label='Map view and filters')
Verify map container exists and is visible (#war-room-map)
Verify zoom controls exist and are visible (button[aria-label='Zoom in'] and button[aria-label='Zoom out'])

title: Switch view modes via toolbar
description: Toggle Project/Client/Manufacturer view mode buttons and confirm the active selection changes without crashes.
steps: On /_dev/fluorescence-map?testsprite=1, locate the three view radios using aria-labels: 'Switch to project view', 'Switch to client view', 'Switch to manufacturer view'
Click the Project View radio (button[aria-label='Switch to project view']); assert it has aria-checked='true' AND the other two have aria-checked='false'
Click the Client View radio (button[aria-label='Switch to client view']); assert it has aria-checked='true' AND the other two have aria-checked='false'
Click the Manufacturer View radio (button[aria-label='Switch to manufacturer view']); assert it has aria-checked='true' AND the other two have aria-checked='false'

title: Zoom interaction shows marker-stability status message
description: Use zoom controls and assert the marker-stability status becomes visible (data-testid marker-stability-status).
steps: On /_dev/fluorescence-map?testsprite=1, click button[aria-label='Zoom in'] twice (with a short wait between clicks)
Wait until an element with data-testid='marker-stability-status' appears and is visible
Confirm the marker-stability-status text contains the word 'Markers'
Click button[aria-label='Zoom out'] twice

title: [Mobile] Resize to mobile viewport and validate shell
description: Set viewport to 375x667 (mobile), open Fluorescence Map, and confirm toolbar and map render without horizontal gap.
steps: Create browser context with mobile viewport: use Playwright context = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 375, 'height': 667}) before creating the page (do not use window resize)

Navigate to /_dev/fluorescence-map?testsprite=1. If redirected to sign-in, fill username 'superadmin', password 'admin123', click button[type='submit'] or button with text 'Sign In', wait for navigation to URL containing 'fluorescence-map'
Wait for role='toolbar' with aria-label='Map view and filters'
Verify #war-room-map is visible and fills width (no grey strip between map and edges)
Verify map view toggle card is visible (Project/Client/Manufacturer buttons)

title: [Mobile] Open and close Activity Log (Panels) bottom sheet
description: Tap Panels button to open Activity Log bottom sheet; verify it is visible; close it and verify it is hidden.
steps: Create browser context with viewport 375x667 (context = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 375, 'height': 667}))

Navigate to /_dev/fluorescence-map?testsprite=1. If sign-in page appears: fill username 'superadmin', password 'admin123', click Sign In button (button[type='submit']), wait for URL to contain 'fluorescence-map'
Click the Panels button (aria-label contains 'Show panels' or button with title 'Show Activity Log')
Wait for aside#war-room-overlay-panel to have class 'open' and be visible
Verify Activity Log content is visible (e.g. text 'ACTIVITY LOG', 'CLIENT', 'MANUFACTURER')
Click the sidebar close button (aria-label='Close panels' or .sidebar-close-btn) or Panels button again
Verify aside#war-room-overlay-panel is no longer visible or has transform hiding it off-screen

title: [Mobile] View toggle and Filter tap targets
description: On mobile, tap Project/Client/Manufacturer view buttons and Filter button; confirm they respond.
steps: Create browser context with viewport 375x667 (context = await browser.new_context(viewport={'width': 375, 'height': 667}))
Navigate to /_dev/fluorescence-map?testsprite=1. If sign-in: fill superadmin / admin123, click Sign In (button[type='submit']), wait for navigation to fluorescence-map
Tap button[aria-label='Switch to client view']; assert it gets aria-checked='true'
Tap the Filter button (title containing 'Filter' or aria-label containing 'filter')
Wait briefly; verify filters panel or filter state changes
Tap Filter again or close to dismiss
